caption:
Tuesday's Sky is Yang Earth, The Mountain ⛰️ Find your element below.

Your element is the element of the day you were born. Today's solid mountain meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yang Earth gets a friend day, Yang Fire gets a joy day, Yang Water feels the pressure.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

Which line is too accurate? Comment below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #horoscope #selfdiscovery #knowyourself #fengshui #fourpillars #chineseastrology #astrologyreels #singapore
day_line: A mountain on a Rat day. Solid and quick: good for planning and steady progress, easy to dig in too hard.

lines.Yang Wood: A chance to grow shows up today. Raise your hand before someone else does.
lines.Yin Wood: Slow and steady pays today. Tick off the admin; future you says thanks.
lines.Yang Fire: You're fun to be around today. Lead the lunch plan and pick somewhere new.
lines.Yin Fire: Your words carry today. Pitch the idea, and keep it to one slide.
lines.Yang Earth: Solid people around you today. Lean on them; return the favour soon.
lines.Yin Earth: Someone wants your spot today. Stay calm and do your part well.
lines.Yang Metal: Quiet focus works today. Headphones on, notifications off.
lines.Yin Metal: Someone steady has your back today. Let them help, then say thank you.
lines.Yang Water: The rules feel tight today. Work within them; your way can wait.
lines.Yin Water: Someone senior notices you today. Be on time and be clear.
